hook: In the United States, 635,808 vehicles risk steering software failures.

sections.voiceover: In the United States, 635,808 vehicles risk steering software failures.
b_roll: Digital graphic depicting steering system failure icon over US map.

sections.voiceover: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration issued recall campaign 26V721 in the United States. How many injuries occurred in these 635,808 vehicles?
b_roll: Official regulatory filing graphic showing recall number 26V721.
Vehicle silhouette graphic highlighting Acura TLX, Acura MDX, and Honda Pilot models.

sections.voiceover: But Honda already received 146 warranty claims and 1 injury report from this software defect.
b_roll: Graphic listing 146 warranty claims alongside 1 injury report.

sections.voiceover: Dealers will reprogram the electronic power steering control unit for all 635,808 recalled Honda vehicles.
b_roll: Diagram illustrating software bug affecting steering control unit.
Map outline showing service center network across the United States.
Chart graphic showing 635,808 automobiles receiving software updates.

sections.voiceover: Recall campaign 26V721 addresses all 635,808 affected vehicles nationwide.
b_roll: Summary graphic showing recall campaign 26V721 and 635,808 total count.
